task.title: To Update from Conga CLM
task.shortdesc: If there are no fields to be updated inside the repeat table, then the Next

step.cmd: Open Microsoft Word and launch the add-in.
Log in to X-Author for Contracts Advanced.
Check out your agreement document. From the Contracts pane, go to the Work tab and click the More button (), and then click Update from CLM.
All the agreement level fields changed in the CLM record are displayed in the X-Author for Contracts pane.
Click Next. The Update from CLM dialog box is displayed.

note.p: If there are no fields to be updated inside the repeat table, then the Next button is not available. The Update button is displayed by default. Click Update to update the remaining fields.

step.cmd: All the repeat table changes and repeat section changes are displayed in the dialog box. Details about the changes such as fields inserted, modified, and deleted are provided.
Review the changed values and click Update to update the field values. A new instance of the Microsoft Word document is opened with the latest updated content.
